title: Warm Gored Delight
description: A sweet and savory Ethiopian-inspired dish made with warm spices and tender gored. Perfect for a cozy evening.

ingredients.name: Warm spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves

ingredients.name: Ethiopian spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of berbere, coriander, and cumin

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together palm sugar, warm spices, and Ethiopian spices.
Add the sliced gored to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the gored mixture to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the gored is tender and lightly caramelized.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
